definitions.explanation: Trousers with a bib front and shoulder straps, worn as casual wear, by small children and as work clothes.

examples.japanese: オーバーオール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦デニム→デニム：21656_denimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧オーバーオール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}せた→着せる：13684_kiseru⟧。
examples.english: I dressed my child in denim overalls.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}{仕事|しごと}→庭仕事：20710_niwashigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{汚|よご}れて→汚れる：01293_yogoreru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧オーバーオール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: When I do garden work, I wear overalls that I don't mind getting dirty.

notes:
In Japanese the word usually means bib overalls (British dungarees). An all-in-one work suit with sleeves is a つなぎ or ⟦{作業着|さぎょうぎ}→作業着：24135_sagyougi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦デニム→デニム：21656_denimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧オーバーオール: denim overalls
- オーバーオール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear overalls
